body.title: Authorize current two-mode review readiness
body.reproduction: Both final-source installed modes completed independently replayed qualification on source 9710ca1f7 and are approved as ISSUE-43237626b4cf3368 and ISSUE-6976db3b0ae15f78. Oracle ISSUE-260d7c2e6ea183cc is independently person-approved. Separate source-only and indexed-impact deterministic evaluations retain every case, defect and coverage row. This manifest pins exact revisions and digests for those four records. Evaluation records ISSUE-94bcfc51783b73fd and ISSUE-2a016fecfd2800fd are pending approval when this manifest is authored; approving this manifest alone cannot waive their approvals.
body.rootCause: The modes have different scoped catalogs and need different evaluation references. Version 2 binds each mode to its own evaluation while preserving current-source, binary/profile, launch-policy, independent-oracle and canonical-approval checks. Approval permits a bounded normal-admission acceptance run; it does not flip the engine default or assert real review quality, token savings or completion of the pending real review. The already approved AMD-8315a11f29fd2812-1 supplies the code-only predecessor reconciliation. Acceptance uses an already completed real Story; this fix Story's mandatory final code review follows task completion, avoiding a review-before-task-pass cycle.
